_notes.discogs_token: Free — create at https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers under 'Generate new token'
_notes.gemini_api_key: From https://aistudio.google.com/apikey — used for photo identification (~$0.00002/photo)
_notes.spotify_client_id: From https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard — create a free app, copy the Client ID
_notes.spotify_client_secret: From the same Spotify app dashboard — copy the Client Secret
_notes.owner_password_hash: Password hash generated with Werkzeug generate_password_hash(). Leave empty to disable auth (not recommended).
_notes.trusted_origins: Optional list of exact allowed browser origins for API requests, e.g. ["https://vinyl.example.com"]
